title: When Does Learned Constraint Selection Pay in Security-Constrained Optimisation? A Boundary Map from SCOPF to Unit Commitment
abstract: arXiv:2611.15142v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning-to-optimise methods for security-constrained optimal power flow (SCOPF) predict the security constraints that bind on each instance and solve only the reduced problem, with reported speed-ups of two to four orders of magnitude over the full problem. We ask whether learned selection beats the strongest learning-free alternative: a fixed umbrella set enforcing every constraint observed to bind in training. Our criterion, the price of a spare, answers this in advance: an enforced but inactive constraint is free, so the umbrella is exactly optimal wherever feasible, and learning can pay only where a spare decision carries a price. We test it systematically, including every PGLib-OPF network up to 10,000 buses. translated_title: 学习型约束选择何时在安全约束优化中有回报？从SCOPF到机组组合的边界图谱
translated_abstract: 针对安全约束最优潮流（SCOPF）的学习优化方法会预测每个实例中哪些安全约束起作用，并仅求解简化后的问题，据报道其速度比完整问题快二至四个数量级。我们探究学习型选择是否能击败最强的无学习替代方案：一个固定的“伞形集合”，它强制执行训练中所有被观察到起作用的约束。我们提出的判据——“备用代价”——可以提前回答这一问题：被强制执行但不起作用的约束是免费的，因此只要问题可行，伞形集合就恰好是最优的，学习只有在备用决策付出代价时才可能有回报。我们进行了系统性测试，涵盖所有不超过10,000节点的PGLib-OPF网络。对于固定网络上的SCOPF，伞形集合从未被击败：在43个网络中其中位数规模仅为5个约束，且无随网络规模增大的趋势，而我们的选择器虽复现了已发表量级的加速（约80,000倍于…
tldr: 本文提出“备用代价”判据，证明在固定网络的SCOPF问题中固定伞形约束集合始终最优、学习型选择无法超越，而学习型约束选择只在机组组合等备用决策产生代价的组合优化场景中才有回报。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a "price of a spare" criterion, proving that a fixed umbrella constraint set is never beaten in SCOPF on fixed networks, and that learned constraint selection only pays off in combinatorial settings like unit commitment where spare decisions carry a price.
